info.title: Wolfgang.Wms API
info.description: Unstable contract for product 0.x: breaking changes ship in place, each with a `breaking` changelog fragment.

get.summary: Current and expected database schema version (read-only).
Every setting the host knows: kind, scopes, default, description (read-only).

current.description: Identifier of the last applied migration, or null when no database is reachable or none was applied.

expected.description: Identifier of the last migration this build ships, or null before the data model exists.

upToDate.description: True when the database is at exactly the migration this build expects.

SchemaStatus.description:
The database schema as the API sees it (E82.5): the migration the database is at and the one this build
expects. Read-only; applying migrations is a bootstrap step outside the API (`wms migrate`).

kind.description: How the value is edited and stored.

scopes.description: The scope names the setting may be configured at, organisation first.

default.description: The default value as stored text; masked for secrets.

choices.description: The allowed values when the kind is a fixed list, else null.

requiresRestart.description: True when a change needs a host restart.

triggersDeviceResync.description: True when a change makes devices resync.

SettingDescriptor.description:
One registry entry as the API and the console see it (E6.1): everything a settings page needs to render
and validate a setting without knowing its CLR type.

SettingKind.description:
How a setting's value is edited and stored (E6.1). Every value is stored as invariant-culture text; the
kind tells the settings page which editor to show and the accessor how to parse the text.
